requiredControls: Fresh host values are read and signed before any write; no previous evidence value may substitute.
The lease proves the exact candidate starts successfully from the freshly recorded absent state path.
The pre-switch absence receipt is recorded before candidate start.
After candidate creation, device, inode, owner, mode, nlink, bytes and SHA-256 are recorded before any rollback decision.
Rollback stops the candidate service and deletes state only if lstat still matches the exact recorded device and inode; mismatch fails closed without deletion.
Final state-path absence is verified before restoring the old service.
The future lease supplies exact signed backup/restore commands for the discovered state mode; unknown state mode fails closed.
Environment replacement is same-directory, atomic, preserves non-WebDir bytes, and has its own verified backup.
The first failure invokes rollback once; the same lease forbids retry.
Both loopback and source-bound public /version and /health must prove either new runtime success or restored old runtime.
